sentences.text:
Sl. Office
No. Date Order Note
03. 10.04.2025 Hn, J
 Heard the learned counsel for the
 petitioner.

The learned counsel for the petitioner
 is permitted to take out personal notice to
 the 2nd respondent through registered p
ost with acknowledgment due and file proof of service in the Registry

. 
The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is arraigned as Accused No. 2 in Crime No. 130 of 2022 on the file of the Seethanagaram Police Station, Parvathipuram, for the alleged offences under Sections 409, 420 r/w 34 of the IPC.
It is submitted that the petitioner is working as an Assistant on a contract basis and, as such, cannot have access to the funds or the stocks which are allegedly misappropriated.
It is also submitted that the petitioner is being made a scapegoat to cover up all the other senior employees of the Civil Supply Corporation.

The learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that the police have Contd..
completed the investigation, and insofar as SL. OFFICE No. DATE ORDER NOTE the petitioner herein is concerned, they are yet to complete the investigation regarding her involvement.

Considering the submissions, there shall be a direction to the Station House Officer, Seethanagaram Police Station, to complete the investigation without taking any coercive steps against the petitioner.
This shall not preclude the filing of the final report after the investigation.
